notes.title: Crow Forest: New World is now the Full version.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
Specially for our transition to the Full Version, I have prepared some surprises for you on our new map. With each update, you'll be able to see hints of the next update as you explore the map.

Again, we will try to evaluate your ideas and add them to the game. For this reason, your comments are very important to us.

Switching to the full version does not mean that our work in the game is over, and we will continue to come up with innovations regularly.

If you have a problem with the opening of the game, deleting and reinstalling it will solve the problem.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]
Best regards...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: Crow Forest: New World 0.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]

With the new update, you must now find a flashlight that can follow the days and you will have to escape from the animals that attack you at night, otherwise the night may be difficult for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

- Day cycle added.
- Rain added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

- Fixed the number of slots on wearables.
- Removed the refillable feature of bottles.
- Flasks rearranged as refillable
- Fixed the problem of mismatch between the icons and items on the wearables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

There is still the possibility of corruption of save files in games as a result of the update, so we apologize in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

In our next update, the map is planned to be expanded and many additions with new areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

We need your feedback to provide you with a better gaming experience. Thank you for your interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: The release date of our game is approaching
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]


We are proud to announce that the planned arrangements that had to be made before our game went on sale are almost finished. We are excited to meet with you very soon. Considering the feedback we received and the positive and constructive comments we received during the testing phase, we see that we have been successful in our efforts to offer a pleasant game to the fog.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]



With the release of our game, we will inform you of our roadmap at regular intervals and we have no doubt that you will be working to provide a better gaming experience by concentrating on continuous improvements and that you will support us in this regard.


Don't forget to add it to your wish list to be notified of our exit


Best regards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/f6e8d8e4c9bf152f8dbf43fdcc0b9f9ed6451870.png[/img]

notes.title: Crow Forest : New World 0.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/fa4d8c7f23a4510bfa66826fd6509e215d1db9b0.png[/img]
You may encounter issues such as saved game deletion or corruption that may occur as a result of updates, and we are doing our best to avoid this issue during the early access process, thank you for your understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

Added hunting animal mechanics
Added aggressive animal mechanics
New Loot Zones added
New Tips added to loading screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

Fixed errors on the map
Fixed an issue where Strawberry was lost when collecting
The mechanics of the demolition of the structures have been fixed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516761/a8831ba240cbd7cc7f385a29726c52e4be827b40.png[/img]

Increased the amount of water contained in the flask from 1 unit to 2 units
Added invisible walls to map borders 
Among the huntable animals, there are aggressive and passive deer, and in every herd there is an aggressive deer, and antler skin and meat can be utilized.


Wolves are aggressive and can also hunt, their skin and meat can be exploited.

You will be able to find more lootable materials on the map.


work was started for the arrangement of the map.
